tool.name: crypt4gh_output_kinds
tool.description: writes its input through every kind of tool output
tool.command: cat '$input1' > '$declared' && cat '$input1' > from_work_dir.txt && cat '$input1' > assigned.primary.txt && mkdir -p discovered split && cat '$input1' > discovered/disc1.txt && cat '$input1' > discovered/disc2.txt && cat '$input1' > split/element1.txt && cat '$input1' > split/element2.txt && cat '$input1' > with_metadata.report.tsv && mkdir -p '$composite.extra_files_path' && cat '$input1' > '$composite.extra_files_path/part.txt' && echo '<html/>' > '$composite' && cp '$galaxy_json' galaxy.json
